nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract; controls all onlyOwner privileged functions.
Mapping of reflection balances per account; source of truth for token ownership.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount, read and written by approve/transferFrom.
Total reflection supply, decremented by _reflectFee whenever a fee is burned.
Constant total token supply used together with _rTotal to derive the reflection rate.
Accumulated token fee total tracked by _reflectFee.
Public blacklist mapping checked in _transfer to block addresses.
Public mapping of accounts allowed to trade before tradingOpen is enabled.
Payable development wallet receiving half of the swapped ETH.
Payable marketing wallet receiving half of the swapped ETH.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity operations.
Address of the FUD/WETH pair created in the constructor.
Boolean gating whether general trading is enabled.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Boolean controlling whether automatic fee swapping is active.
Maximum allowed transfer amount, also used to cap the swapped token balance.
Maximum wallet holding enforced on non-pair transfers.
Threshold of accumulated contract tokens that triggers an automatic swap.
Mapping of accounts excluded from fees and from triggering swaps.
Fee configuration state variables for reflection and team/tax fees on buys and sells.
Core private transfer routine enforcing limits, blacklists, trading gate, fee selection and automatic swap.
Private function that approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH via the Uniswap router, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Private function that splits the contract ETH balance between the development and marketing addresses.
External function allowing the dev/marketing address to manually trigger a token swap.
External function allowing the dev/marketing address to manually distribute contract ETH.
Owner-only function toggling the tradingOpen flag.
Owner-only function adding addresses to the bots blacklist.
Owner-only function removing an address from the bots blacklist.
Private function that optionally zeroes and restores fees around the standard transfer.
Private function performing the reflection balance accounting and emitting the Transfer event.
Private function crediting the contract with the team/tax portion of reflections.
Private function burning the reflection fee from _rTotal and accumulating _tFeeTotal.
Private view function computing token and reflection amounts for a transfer.
Private view function computing the reflection rate from current supplies.
Private view function returning the current reflection and token supplies.

Public ERC20 transferFrom entry point that transfers and then decrements the allowance.
Public ERC20 approve entry point updating the allowance mapping.
Public view function converting an account's reflection balance to a token balance.
Owner-only function updating buy/sell reflection and tax fees.
Owner-only function updating the maximum transaction amount.
Owner-only function batch-updating the fee exclusion mapping.
Owner-only function toggling pre-trading permission for an account.
Deployer sets up owner, router, pair, exclusions, pre-traders and bot blacklist.
Public view returning the stored owner address.
Modifier enforcing _owner == _msgSender() for privileged functions.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and transfer origination.
Miner-influenceable timestamp passed as the router swap deadline.
External call to the Uniswap router performing a token-to-ETH swap with amountOutMin = 0.
External ETH transfers pushing funds to the hardcoded fee addresses.

Sender address parameter of _transfer.

edges.reason: manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to the fee addresses, so msg.sender drives the privileged branch.
manualsend gates execution on _msgSender() being the development or marketing address.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender and allowance owner.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
Caller-derived addresses reach _transfer through the public ERC20 entry points.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline, making execution time-dependent.
The block.timestamp deadline flows into the external router swap call.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when accumulated fees exceed the swap threshold.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance after swapping.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with contract-controlled parameters.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH out to the developer and marketing addresses.
_developmentAddress is the recipient of half the transferred ETH.
_marketingAddress is the recipient of half the transferred ETH.
uniswapV2Router is the target contract of the swap call.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to determine fee and swap behaviour.
inSwap reentrancy guard is read before triggering the swap.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap inside _transfer.
_maxTxAmount limits the transfer amount and caps the swapped token balance.
_maxWalletSize bounds the recipient token balance.
_swapTokensAtAmount sets the automatic swap trigger threshold.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether fees and swaps apply to from/to.
bots mapping blocks blacklisted senders and recipients.
preTrader mapping controls the pre-trading window.
tradingOpen gates transfers before trading is enabled.
owner() is compared against from and to to decide fee treatment.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
manualswap validates the caller identity through a _msgSender() comparison.
_transfer delegates balance accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to move reflections.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to accumulate team tokens.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn reflections.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute transfer amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current reflection rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for the total supplies.
_rOwned balances are debited and credited inside _transferStandard.
_takeTeam credits the _rOwned balance of the contract.
balanceOf converts the account's _rOwned value through tokenFromReflection.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee into _tFeeTotal.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal.
transfer enters _transfer.
transferFrom enters _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance via _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and subtracts from the _allowances mapping.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts setTrading to the owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts setFee to the owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts setMaxTxnAmount to the owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees to the owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts allowPreTrading to the owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts blockBots to the owner.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts unblockBot to the owner.
onlyOwner compares the stored _owner with _msgSender() to authorize the call.
setFee writes the buy/sell reflection and tax fee state variables.
setMaxTxnAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
blockBots writes entries into the bots blacklist mapping.
unblockBot clears an entry in the bots blacklist mapping.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFee mapping.
allowPreTrading writes the preTrader mapping.
The constructor assigns the Uniswap router instance.
The constructor calls createPair on the Uniswap factory.
The constructor stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
The Ownable constructor sets _owner to the deploying account.
The constructor marks the owner as a pre-trader.
The constructor pre-populates the bots blacklist with known addresses.
The constructor mints the entire reflection supply to the deployer.
The constructor excludes the owner and fee addresses from fees.
owner() returns the stored _owner state variable.
balanceOf indirectly reaches _getRate through tokenFromReflection.
The router swap performs external token/ETH transfers that could re-enter swapTokensForEth, only partially mitigated by the inSwap flag.
The ETH transfers in sendETHToFee invoke external addresses and could re-enter the fee distribution path, though gas forwarding is limited.
The from parameter flows into the _transfer validation and accounting logic.
The to parameter flows into the _transfer validation and accounting logic.
The amount parameter is checked against _maxTxAmount and transferred.
The tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
The path array is passed as a calldata argument to the router swap.
The amount parameter of sendETHToFee is split and transferred out.
The contractBalance local in manualswap is passed to swapTokensForEth.
The contractETHBalance local in manualsend is passed to sendETHToFee.
The accounts array is iterated to update the fee exclusion mapping.
The excluded boolean is written into _isExcludedFromFee for each account.
The account parameter is used to look up and update the preTrader mapping.
The allowed boolean is written into the preTrader mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer and should collapse into that function's dataflow node.
The to parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer and should collapse into that function's dataflow node.
The amount parameter of _transfer is a transient value validated and consumed by the function.
The tokenAmount parameter is only used as the swap input inside swapTokensForEth.
The local path array is constructed solely to feed the external router swap call.
The contractBalance local exists only to feed swapTokensForEth from manualswap.
The contractETHBalance local exists only to feed sendETHToFee from manualsend.
The accounts array is a transient iteration input for the fee exclusion loop.
The excluded boolean is a transient value written into _isExcludedFromFee.
The account parameter is a transient lookup key for the preTrader mapping.
The allowed boolean is a transient value written into the preTrader mapping.
